scope: Structural/provenance audit only; no claim of semantic reading of whole session. Original sources read-only. Raw normalization is extraction, not comprehension.

repaired_export.schema: Each record retains untouched raw event/DB row, original source locator, actor, source sequence, full-precision timestamp. No deduplication/filtering/semantic classification. Raw bytes encoded as hex where needed. Actor knowledge follows actor sequence, not global wall time.
repaired_export.snapshot_note: Hermes read in one explicit SQLite read transaction; JSONL selected files copied eventwise without omission. Live sources may subsequently grow.

findings.finding: Exact text match is labeled replay and skips whole assistant record before processing its calls. 129 assistant records and 53 user records suppressed; 66 suppressed assistant records have tool_calls. Repetition is not evidence of transport replay.
findings.evidence: source/export2.py Hermes seen/hash/continue; raw-source-manifest.json repeated record IDs
findings.repair: Read original native-order records with IDs and active/compacted/display metadata. Preserve all occurrences; infer replay only from identity and source context.

findings.finding: Codex drops developer messages, XML-leading user messages, turn_context, world_state and compaction events. Selected raw sources contain 111 developer messages, 33 XML-leading user messages, 450 turn_context, 114 world_state and 76 compacted records.
findings.repair: Restored in raw-source. Readers track context changes and summaries at actual exposure positions.

findings.finding: Codex agent_message records are omitted entirely. Many payloads and some outgoing collaboration calls are encrypted in stored source.
findings.evidence: source/export2.py recognized types; raw-source Codex response_item agent_message and collaboration calls
findings.repair: Preserved raw; plaintext unavailable must be marked unavailable. Do not reconstruct parent knowledge by silently substituting child full history.

findings.finding: Global merged ordering truncates timestamps to seconds; source-call IDs, original ordinals and actor metadata are lost. Global availability is not actor exposure.
findings.repair: Use each actor source order; retain original timestamp, ordinal, call_id, thread/turn IDs, parent and delivery links. Merge for display only.

findings.finding: Exporter selected hard-coded Hermes parents, 10 Codex files by first-line cwd substring, 4 top-level Claude files. 119 Hermes candidate sessions (includes selected parents and child sessions) and 22 Claude nested subagent files exist. This is not a verified complete corpus.
findings.repair: Bounded linked-source recovery: inspect named children/forks when establishing action outcomes or delivered context. Do not blanket import unrelated projects.

findings.finding: Claude export omits sidechains, isMeta and XML-leading user text, attachment/system/file-history/queue records, thinking and nontext content.
findings.repair: All top-level source events now preserved. Determine visibility from native parent UUIDs/sidechain/attachment semantics rather than role guesses.

findings.finding: Exporter drops session metadata and row fields such as active, compacted, _compressed_summary, api_content, display_metadata, tool_call_id. Current DB flags do not alone establish historical exposure.
findings.evidence: raw-source first metadata rows and full message rows
findings.repair: Preserved all fields under explicit SQLite read transaction. Use native IDs and summary insertion to understand transitions.

findings.finding: All 15,575 full/ references in all.txt exist in snapshot. Nevertheless the reading spec still references old ACTIONS collapse and omission policy, and full payload existence is not evidence they were read.
findings.repair: Use full native source reading plus explicit coverage records. Supersede old spec; source/all.txt is a convenience index only.

findings.finding: Codex includes 3 primary 01a0f371 continuation files and 3 explicit child actor files carrying inherited context. UI item_completed may mirror response_item. Equal text is insufficient for dedup.
findings.repair: Preserve raw; identify same occurrence from original ordinal/item/call/turn IDs and history_base. Keep inherited child exposure distinct from fresh action. Pure token telemetry may be excluded from semantic reading with counts recorded.

findings.finding: A historical artifact can confirm a change without proving the actor had read it. Current repo state cannot substitute for historical context.
findings.evidence: Source structure: tool results vs git artifact history
findings.repair: Use received tool/message contents for knowledge; timestamped artifacts for independent outcome verification. Track unavailable original tool output/truncation separately.

remaining_limits: Encrypted stored contents unavailable as semantic evidence.
Linked delegate population identified but not yet fully exported or semantically read.
Original runtime may have truncated outputs before persistence; full stored result means full available stored result, not original command output.
Native replay/fork exposure requires identity/ancestry interpretation; raw preserves all records without assuming equal text equals duplication.
